rationale: The stock is trading significantly below its session VWAP ($30.18 vs $30.89) and has failed to hold the 9-EMA, indicating bearish momentum following a massive gap-up that has largely retraced. The lack of news catalysts and the high relative volume suggest a potential "blow-off" top or distribution phase, but the price is currently consolidating near the 50% retracement level, making the risk/reward for either a long (catching a falling knife) or short (fighting the gap) unfavorable without a clear break of the recent 1-minute range.
